Title: Diagnosis
Details: The failing test `testIntersectionParallel` creates two parallel sublines and calls the `SubLine.intersection(SubLine, boolean)` method in line 151, expecting the result to be null as they do not intersect. The test fails with a NullPointerException (NPE).

Looking at the `SubLine.intersection` method (lines 110-131), it calls `line1.intersection(line2)`, which returns the intersection point of the underlying infinite lines or null if they are parallel or do not intersect (line 117). 

We see that if the lines are parallel, `line1.intersection(line2)` returns null (line 200). Then `SubLine.intersection` calls `line1.toSubSpace(v2D)` and `line2.toSubSpace(v2D)` on the intersection point `v2D` without null checks (lines 120 and 123). Since `v2D` is null, this causes a NullPointerException in the `toSubSpace` method.

The bug is that `SubLine.intersection` does not guard against null intersection points returned by the underlying `Line.intersection`. The expected behavior when lines do not intersect is to return null, but it instead attempts to proceed and throws an NPE.

The bug report confirms this by saying calling `SubLine.intersection` on non-intersecting lines causes NPE in `Line.toSubSpace`. The attached patch presumably adds null checks or returns null correctly.

The test `testIntersectionParallel` triggers this issue by intersecting parallel sublines, causing the underlying line intersection to return null, leading to the NPE in the current code.

Hence, the cause of the bug is missing null checks in `SubLine.intersection` to verify if the underlying infinite line intersection point is non-null before trying to project it and check region location.

No other recent bug reports appear relevant to this geometry intersection and null check issue.

Summary: The bug occurs because `SubLine.intersection` does not handle the case when underlying infinite line intersection is null for parallel or non-intersecting lines, causing a null pointer exception at `Line.toSubSpace`.

Suggested fix: Add a null check after `line1.intersection(line2)` and return null immediately if no intersection point exists. This aligns with the expected contract of returning null for no intersection.

This explains the test failure and matches the current bug report description exactly.
